summary: 麻黄碱是一种拟交感胺，常用作兴奋剂、集中注意力、减充血、抑制食欲，并用于治疗麻醉相关低血压。为甲基苯丙胺的类似物，常用于甲基苯丙胺生产。
effectsSummary: Ephedrine has a stimulating effect. It increases alertness, energy, and focus. It also acts as a bronchodilator and decongestant.
generalRisks: Increased heart rate and blood pressure, anxiety, insomnia, palpitations. Risk of heart problems in susceptible individuals.
longtermRisks: Regular use may lead to cardiovascular strain and psychological dependence.
saferUse: 如果有心脏问题避免使用。
避免与其他兴奋剂同用。
不要在晚间使用以避免失眠。
